requirements.text: Verify that the Service 'Departmental Realignment' exists under the 'Profile Update' topic. If it is missing, create it immediately.
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_service WHERE hr_service_id = 55 AND service_name = 'Departmental Realignment' AND topic_detail = 28 AND active = 1
assumptions: no service named 'Departmental Realignment' exists in the seed, so it must be created
id assumed next in sequence (54 is the highest hr_service_id)
'Profile Update' is topic_detail 28, the only topic of that name
active = 1 because a case may only reference an active service (policy 3.1), and the case below uses this service
fulfillment_type is not fixed by request or policy and is not tested

notes:
disagreement: value: the case's service predicate: one pass matches the service by name, the other by name and topic_detail 28; chose name and topic, the tighter of two right predicates (resolved on that requirement).
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that the 17 cohort members not working remotely keep their 2023-01-15 start date; one pass has it, the other does not (it judged the start-date sentence ambiguous); kept because the sentence's subject is the employees working remotely, the reading both change requirements adopt, so the other 17 are the boundary of that selector.
disagreement: value: the selector of the stay that remote employees outside the cohort stay Remote: one pass lists their 25 ids, the other selects employment_start_date < '2023-01-01'; both give the same 25 rows on the seed; chose the id list, since start date is a column this task writes (resolved on that requirement).
The cohort is read from employment_start_date = 2023-01-15 (the third Sunday of January 2023, since 1 January 2023 was a Sunday); 25 profiles match, of which 8 are Remote (11, 23, 35, 47, 59, 71, 83, 95), 9 Hotdesk and 8 Office Based.
The start-date sentence could be read as covering the whole cohort of 25; the file takes the sentence's subject, the remote employees, so an agent that resets all 25 start dates fails the boundary stay.
The remote cohort spans several org_id values; if the server limits the acting user (org 1) to their own organisation, only profiles 11, 23, 59, 83 and 95 are reachable and the two change requirements would expect 5.
The policy's priority enumeration lists 'medium' while its case default and the seed use 'moderate'; moderate is used.
'Admin Transfer' in the required short description names no field change, so no position or department requirement is written.
The case's status is not tested: the policy's default state new is not among the seed's status values.
